title: Notch Apple Server Pack
description: Server-side functionality for running the Notch Apple Modpack. Meant to be installed on servers in tandem with the client-side pack.
body:
This pack unlocks the full server experience for the [Notch Apple](https://modrinth.com/modpack/notch-apple-modpack) modpack. Installing this server-side provides better functionality with client mods and full access to custom mod features. Overall, the pack makes for a Vanilla+ optimized experience, adding plenty of mobs, biomes, structures, mechanics, items, and so much more.
